name: PT Bank Multiarta Sentosa Tbk
summary: PT Bank Multiarta Sentosa Tbk is an Indonesian financial institution offering a broad spectrum of banking solutions. Its services include a variety of deposit accounts, such as checking, savings, foreign currency, and term deposits, along with diverse credit options like working capital, investment, and consumer loans. The bank also provides essential financial services such as remittances, international trade support (exports and imports), clearing, fund transfers, currency exchange, payroll management, and bill payment. Additional conveniences include safe deposit boxes, digital banking platforms (internet and mobile), and ATM cards. By the end of 2021, the company had established a physical network comprising 13 branches and 21 sub-branches. Founded in 1992 and headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia, it operates as a subsidiary of Pt Danabina Sentana.
